Arjun (infra): Heads-up — nightshift maintenance scheduled for az-apac-west1 tonight 00:30-02:30 UTC. Plan is a VLAN split + allocator migration to reduce egress contention on APAC racks. We'll do soft drains and rolling node reboots across ~12 racks. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/apac-vlan-split (draft). :warning:
Mei (sre): What's the expected GPU capacity impact? Need numbers for customer comms and alerting thresholds.
Arjun (infra): Rough estimate: 8-12% tail-end capacity hit in APAC saturn pool during peak of the operation. Most of that comes from 3 interruptible racks we will cordon first. We will backfill from us-west burst pool; cost estimate roughly ~$1.5k extra for the window (spot usage).
Sarah - oncall: Can we do a canary? Prefer to migrate 2 racks first and hold 15m to watch p99 and KV cache warmups. Also want to avoid large token-burst billing jumps.
Arjun (infra): Yes — canary at 00:30 on rack-a2 and rack-a3. Hold 15m, run smoke (p99 < 150ms, error rate <0.5%). If green, continue with 2-rack cohorts every 12 minutes. Abort criteria: >2% sustained SLA impact or >1% increase in 5xx.
Kyle (devops): I'll run the allocator migration and tag nodes for fast rollback. Script I'll run: ```#!/bin/bash
# migrate allocator
./bin/allocator migrate --from=old-vlan --to=new-vlan --cohort=canary --dry-run=false
```
Kyle (devops): I'll also push a small throttle rule to the egress qdisc to avoid downstream saturation during warmup.
infra-bot: Maintenance ticket created: INFR-10234. Pager duty rotation set: Sarah -> Mei. Automatic rollback hook enabled.
Mei (sre): I'll update status page and ping dedicated account owners. Message draft: "We will perform rolling updates in APAC; brief capacity degradation possible. No planned downtime for hosted API; enterprise dedicated customers may see transient capacity changes." Will post at 23:45 UTC.
Sarah - oncall: I'll be on-call cover 23:45-03:30. I'll monitor latency dashboards and queue depth. Ping me in this thread if anything crosses thresholds.
Kyle (devops): Reminder — preheat KV cache after each cohort using the seed job: ```curl -XPOST https://internal/kvseed?cohort=$COHORT``` Warmup target: seed 80% of active prefixes within 10m.
Arjun (infra): Also note network-team will run low-impact switch config push at 01:20; it aligns with cohort 4. They've promised <30s control-plane flaps, but we should treat as potential rollback trigger.
Mei (sre): Got it. I'll set alerting for control-plane flaps -> escalate to network oncall.
Sarah - oncall: If any cohort fails canary, we'll rollback allocator on that cohort and reassign traffic to us-west for affected tenants.
Arjun (infra): TL;DR: canary 00:30, cohorts every ~12m, runbackfill from us-west, warm KV seed, metrics gating p99<150ms and <0.5% 5xx. Cost/impact estimate attached in ticket. Please ack. :thumbsup:
Mei (sre): ack
Kyle (devops): ack
Sarah - oncall: ack
